systems.owner: Each commune, the mayor being charged with keeping it and able to delegate it to heads of arrondissement; designed, implemented and governed by the Agence Nationale d'Identification des Personnes (ANIP)
systems.tiers: Every commune, by the law of 19 June 2017: two registers (Beninese and foreign residents), kept up to date with resources the government allocates to each commune; data pass to the national register electronically, or on paper within fifteen days where that is impossible
National; the law gives mayors and heads of arrondissement access to consult it
National; operated and consulted online by police, gendarmerie, customs and the issuing authorities

note: A law: it requires each commune to keep a register of persons and gives mayors access to the national register, with electronic transmission as the rule. It prescribes and does not state that any commune office is connected. A law places nothing.
